sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 170. Applies Miasma for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 170. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 140. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all allies. Applies 100% damage reflection for 40 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 60000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 60000
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 500-Ability-Power attack that deals magic time damage to all enemies 5 times at a success value of 100 by 500.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
Only [Velvet Room Resident] Elizabeth can be used as Unlocking Potential material
